children: Revenue Up 18.4% Year Over Year, Driven by Deepened Partnership and Expanded Service Offerings
FUZHOU, China, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Shengfeng Development Limited ("Shengfeng" or the "Company") (
), a contract logistics company in China providing customers with integrated logistics solutions, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

: Increased by approximately 18.4% from approximately $263.4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $311.8 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The increase was primarily driven by a significant increase in revenue from our transportation services.

: Increased by approximately 11.3% from approximately $24.1 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $26.8 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. For the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, our overall gross margin was approximately 8.6% and 9.1%, respectively. The gross margin decreased primarily due to competitive pricing pressures in the market.
: Increased by 9.6% from approximately $6.0 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $6.6 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
: Operating expenses increased by approximately 9.1% from approximately $16.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $17.8 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

: Decreased by approximately 20.4% from approximately $2.9 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $2.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The decrease was primarily attributable to lower employee salaries and related benefits, driven by a decrease in sales department headcount as a result of the Company's departmental restructuring.

: Increased by approximately 15.4% from approximately $13.4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $15.5 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The increase was primarily attributable to higher employee salaries and related benefits, driven by an increase in G&A department headcount as a result of the Company's departmental restructuring.

: Cash and cash equivalents was approximately $16.9 million, as of June 30, 2026, decreased from approximately $35.3 million as of December 31, 2025. The decrease was primarily due to investments in business expansion and increased working capital requirements to support the growth in revenue. The Company remains committed to maintaining a strong liquidity position to support ongoing operations and strategic initiatives.

: Net revenues increased by approximately 18.4% from approximately $254.7 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $301.6 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The growth was primarily driven by the expansion of services with existing clients, reflecting a deepened partnership and expanded service offerings.

: Revenues increased by approximately 14.9% from approximately $7.1 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025 to approximately $8.1 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The increase was primarily due to the acquisition of new clients for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

Mr. Yongxu Liu, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Shengfeng, commented, "Shengfeng delivered solid revenue growth in the first six months of 2026. Most of that growth came from customers we were already serving, who over the period chose to place a wider share of their logistics operations in our hands. New energy vehicles remained a core client segment, where we serve leading battery manufacturers and vehicle brands. We also deepened our work with major fast-moving consumer goods customers and with global industrial equipment manufacturers, while our warehouse storage management business grew on the strength of new customer acquisition. We supported this growth without a proportionate increase in overhead. For the second half of 2026, our attention is expected to turn to network and route optimization, the utilization of our transportation capacity, and the management of working capital, as we aim to translate revenue growth into stronger profitability."

Looking ahead, Shengfeng aims to sustain its growth and improve margins in the second half of 2026. The Company is committed to leveraging its extensive logistics network and innovative solutions to serve a broader range of industries and customers.

Shengfeng Development Limited is a contract logistics company in China providing customers with integrated logistics solution services. Established in 2001, the Company has developed extensive and reliable transportation networks in China, covering 382 cities across 32 provinces, as of June 30, 2026. The Company provides integrated logistics solutions comprised of B2B freight transportation services, warehouse storage management services, and value-added services. The Company applies well-established management systems and operating procedures to assist companies in China to increase efficiency and improve their own management systems with respect to transportation, warehousing and time management. For more information, please visit the Company's website: http://ir.sfwl.com.cn/.
